lastCompletedStory.title: Wire `cam ship --finalize` into dispatch, bypassing the thin-proxy

nextStoryContext: US-002 done: parseShipArgs now returns {help, finalize}, dispatchShip (exported) routes --finalize to finalizeCycleClose in-process (no tmux) and the thin-proxy path to runShip. ShipDispatchDeps interface is exported from index.ts for test injection. _buildFinalizeOpts() builds production deps (spawnSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, join). All oracles pass. Next story can wire finalizeCycleClose into the supervisor or add the /cam-ship --finalize operator story.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Implementation uses only node builtins (node:child_process spawnSync, node:fs readFileSync/writeFileSync, node:path join) and the in-repo finalizeCycleClose from ship-finalize.ts (validated in US-001). No new external library API was called.
